page.content:
Tragedy of the Moor of Venice, Desdemona, and Iago's lie.

How Othello connects

  • Character: Othello (the Moor) — Othello is the title general of Othello.
  • Creator: William Shakespeare — William Shakespeare wrote Othello.
  • Character: Iago — Iago is the ensign who engineers the jealousy plot.
  • Concept: Shakespearean tragedy — Othello is a central Shakespearean tragedy.

What is Othello?

Othello is the jealousy play: a general who loves Desdemona, a lieutenant who hates him, and a handkerchief that Iago turns into proof.

Key threads lead to Othello (the Moor), William Shakespeare, Iago and Shakespearean tragedy.
